id: title:jabahamondes:keep table headers visible while scrolling

review.reason: The change adds viewport height and content scrolling support to the Marketing Analytics table, retaining warehouse ingestion and scheduling. P1.F4.H1 adds a max-height constraint, and P1.F3.H1 enables content scrolling. This is a localized, bounded UI improvement rather than a systemic capability or correctness fix.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is dominated by snapshot and documentation changes; the actual implementation is minimal and localized, not systemic. No broader architectural or reliability benefit is demonstrated.
